campaign.name: FIBEN v1 small live check
campaign.note: v1 predates the Semantic Ladder: arms are mapped to their nearest rung, one run each, unanswerable suite unstratified (24 questions, results reconstructed from the run summaries). K4 runs used the v1 glossary (Gv1), which was written after seeing all gold SQL: those results are possibly contaminated (spec §4.5).

cq01_listed_security_is_security.question: Is every listed security a security (and a financial instrument)?

cq02_agents.question: Are persons and corporations both autonomous agents?

cq03_revenue_is_statement_element.question: Is revenue reported as an element of a financial statement?

cq04_statement_measures.question: Do expense, liability, asset and equity figures all roll up to financial-statement elements?

cq05_account_owner.question: Who owns an account? (an account is related to the person who owns it)

cq07_holding_security.question: Which security does a holding refer to?

cq08_holding_account.question: In which account is a holding held?

cq09_trade_account.question: Through which account was a securities transaction made?

cq11_market.question: On which market is a security traded?

cq12_report_provider.question: Which corporation provided a financial report?

cq13_report_member.question: Which report does a financial-statement element belong to?

cq15_price.question: What is the last traded price of a listed security, as an amount?

cq16_industry.question: In which industry sector is a corporation classified?

cq17_figure_value_year.question: Does a financial-statement figure carry a value and a fiscal year?
